intro.en: I am a master's student in Computer and Information Engineering at The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen. My research focuses on embodied AI, multi-robot collaboration, and efficient long-horizon task planning.
intro.zh: 我是香港中文大学（深圳）计算机与信息工程专业的硕士生，研究方向包括具身智能、多机器人协同与高效长时域任务规划。

researchIntro.en: I study how robots can turn incomplete observations into reliable plans: connecting language-based reasoning, symbolic task models, and coordinated action in the physical world.
researchIntro.zh: 我关注机器人如何在信息不完整的环境中形成可靠的计划，将语言推理、符号任务模型与真实世界中的协同行动连接起来。

text.en: Long-horizon planning, language agents, and uncertainty-aware symbolic reasoning.
text.zh: 长时域任务规划、大语言模型智能体与不确定性感知的符号推理。

text.en: Task allocation, resource coordination, and active exploration with robot teams.
text.zh: 面向机器人团队的任务分配、资源协调与主动探索。

text.en: Object navigation, spatial understanding, and deployment on real robots.
text.zh: 目标导航、空间理解，以及从仿真到真实机器人的系统部署。

papers.title: ELHPlan: Efficient Long-Horizon Task Planning for Multi-Agent Collaboration

alt.en: ELHPlan action-chain planning and collaboration framework
alt.zh: ELHPlan 动作链规划与多智能体协同框架图

summary.en: Intention-bound Action Chains combine longer planning horizons with proactive feasibility checks and targeted refinement in partially observable environments.
summary.zh: 以意图绑定的 Action Chain 为规划单元，通过主动可行性检查与局部修正，在部分可观测环境中实现长时域协同规划。

contribution.en: Designed and implemented the planning framework, validation and refinement mechanisms, and experimental pipeline.
contribution.zh: 负责整体规划框架、可行性验证与修正机制、实验平台搭建和论文撰写。

highlight.en: 30–40% of baseline token usage on TDW-MAT and C-WAH
highlight.zh: 在 TDW-MAT 与 C-WAH 中，token 消耗为对比方法的 30–40%

papers.title: AECNav: Active Evidence Consolidation for Efficient Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Object Navigation

alt.zh: AECNav 证据驱动的开放词汇目标导航概览

summary.en: A training-free navigation pipeline that consolidates visual evidence, confirms targets, and actively explores unseen environments.
summary.zh: 无需任务专用训练的开放词汇目标导航方法，通过视觉证据融合、可靠目标确认与主动探索应对未知环境。

contribution.en: Contributed to target evidence fusion, active exploration, and experimental validation.
contribution.zh: 参与目标证据融合、主动探索设计与实验验证。

highlight.zh: 四足机器人实机测试：40 次试验，95% 成功率

papers.title: Keep It in Mind: User Centric Continual Spatial Intelligence Reasoning in Egocentric Video Streams

alt.en: UCS-Bench egocentric video streams and spatial reasoning evaluation
alt.zh: UCS-Bench 第一人称视频流与空间推理评测

summary.en: Continual spatial reasoning over egocentric video streams, connecting visual observations, spatial memory, and the user’s changing viewpoint.
summary.zh: 面向第一人称视频流的持续空间推理，连接视觉观测、空间记忆与用户不断变化的视角。

contribution.en: Contributed to data quality management, annotation workflow design, and vision-language model evaluation.
contribution.zh: 参与数据质量管理、标注流程设计与视觉语言模型评测。

papers.title: Multi-agent Active Exploration Framework Based on Topological Map Fusion for Indoor Environments

alt.en: Multi-robot active exploration and topological map fusion
alt.zh: 多机器人主动探索与拓扑地图融合系统

summary.en: Collaborative indoor exploration through topological map fusion, connecting heterogeneous robots in a shared exploration system.
summary.zh: 通过拓扑地图融合实现室内多机器人主动探索，将异构机器人接入统一的协同探索系统。

contribution.en: Real-robot deployment on MR-600, Petbot, and Spark: ROS integration, sensors, communication, and map fusion.
contribution.zh: 负责 MR-600、Petbot 和 Spark 平台实机部署，完成 ROS 集成、传感器适配、通信与地图融合。

papers.title: A Novel Prompt Tuning for Graph Transformers: Tailoring Prompts to Graph Topologies

summary.en: Topology-specific prompts for adapting graph transformers to different graph structures.
summary.zh: 根据图的拓扑结构构建特定提示，使图 Transformer 适应不同图结构。

contribution.en: Data preprocessing, experiment configuration, benchmark evaluation, and result analysis.
contribution.zh: 参与数据预处理、实验配置、基准评测与结果分析。

papers.title: Beyond Direct Relationships: Exploring Multi-Order Label Pair Dependencies for Knowledge Distillation

summary.en: Multi-order label dependencies for knowledge distillation in multi-label image classification.
summary.zh: 利用多阶标签依赖关系，改进多标签图像分类中的知识蒸馏。

contribution.en: Data processing, training configuration, and experimental evaluation on Pascal VOC and MS-COCO.
contribution.zh: 参与数据处理、训练配置，以及 Pascal VOC 和 MS-COCO 上的实验评估。

detail.zh: 设计并维护 ROS 移动机器人导航实验，以英文授课并指导学生完成导航任务与系统调试。

org.zh: 深圳市人工智能与机器人研究院

detail.en: Worked on LLM-based task planning, multi-robot scheduling, and navigation system implementation.
detail.zh: 参与基于 LLM 的任务规划、多机器人任务调度与导航系统实现。
